notes: Run of 2026-11-25. Six Registry stories queued; four name San Francisco buildings. Published: Thor Equities' $50.5MM purchase of 55 Stockton. Pending: Anthropic's 98,000 sq ft lease of the former food-production building at 2000–2040 Folsom, a range that spans two parcels. Declined: the Google Store lease at 222 Stockton (the Standard's readable account, published earlier the same evening, carries it) and Meta weighing a sublease at 250 Howard (not an event). The robotics-demand and office-requirements stories name SF addresses only in sidebar links.

findings.description: Google leased the former Tory Burch storefront at 222 Stockton for its first San Francisco store.

citation.label: The Registry, “Google Leases 4,000 SQFT at 222 Stockton for First San Francisco Store, Facing Apple in Union Square,” 24 November 2026

raw.text: Alphabet's Google has signed a long-term lease for the former Tory Burch storefront at 222 Stockton Street

publish.note: Declined: a second account. The San Francisco Standard reported the same lease earlier the same evening, readable in full, and carries the entry (news/items/sf-standard/2026-11-25.json, 2026-11-25-ss-0001). The Registry's is paywalled after the lede.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 222 STOCKTON ST → parcel 0309014; sf-parcels has blklot 0309014 active, 218–222 STOCKTON; the 2025 roll records it as commercial misc, built 1908. EAS puts 218, 222 STOCKTON ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 218.

findings.description: Anthropic signed a 98,000 sq ft direct lease of the former food production building at 2000–2040 Folsom in the Mission's industrial district, confirming a deal rumoured in October.

citation.label: The Registry, “Anthropic Signs 98,000 SQFT Lease at 2000-2040 Folsom, Taking AI Research Into San Francisco’s Industrial Mission District,” 24 November 2026

raw.text: Anthropic has signed a 98,000-square-foot direct lease at the former food production building at 2000-2040 Folsom St. in the Mission District

publish.note: Blocked: the resolver will not join the address. The recorded range 2000–2040 Folsom spans two active parcels today, 3571001 (2000 Folsom: a 5,776 sq ft lot the 2025 roll gives no building area) and 3571002 (2014–2030 Folsom, with 3571002A: a 90,045 sq ft industrial building, built 1948). The roll makes 3571002 the likely home of a 98,000 sq ft building, but the article does not say which parcel, and the Registry's '2000 Folsom Street' is only its keyword tag. Same rule as 1354–1356 York. Needs a human to pick the page, or a readable account naming the parcel.

resolution.method: the recorded range 2000-2040 FOLSOM ST on FOLSOM ST spans more than one parcel in sf-eas-addresses today: 3571001 (2000), 3571002 (2014, 2020, 2030).
resolution.note: The numbers the record gives are on different parcels now, so the record cannot be placed on one page without deciding which — which the record does not say.
